description: Use this when the user wants investors reminded of a capital call they have not paid in full. Starts a reminder of the call’s notice to the investors they name, or every investor with something outstanding. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed reminders with their recipients for the user to confirm. This call sends nothing, and Capital Company never moves money.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_resend_capital_call
title: Resend capital call notices
